sanskrit: parivārāḥ kathaṃ devaṃ tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabhoparivāraṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvidhipurassarampurato vṛṣabhasthānaṃ sthāpayedvṛṣabhaṃ tataḥdakṣiṇe mātṛdevīṃśca vighneśaṃ nairṛte tathājyeṣṭhāṃ vāyavyadeśe tu viṣṇuṃ cottaradeśataḥevamantarahāre tu vinyasedaṣṭadaivatānpaścime dvāradehasya paścime vṛṣabhaṃ nyasetuttarāyāṃ diśayoścaiva durgādevīṃ ca vinyasetpūrve tu bhāskarasthānaṃ kumāraṃ cāgnigocaremātṛsthānaṃ tu nairṛtyāṃ subrahmaṇyaṃ tu vāruṇedurgāṃ caṇḍeśa digbhāge bhāskaraṃ pūrvato nyasetuttaradvāragehasya uttare vṛṣabhālayamdurgāmāgneya digbhāge yāmye mātṛgaṇā sthitāḥvāyavyāṃ vinyasejjyeṣṭhāṃ viśeṣeṇa vicakṣaṇaḥṣoḍaśadvāradevāṃśca vakṣyāmi munisattamayamanairṛtayormadhye pitṛsthānaṃ vidhīyatevaruṇavāyavyayormadhye ṛṣīṇāṃ sthānamucyatesomīśānayormadhye aṣṭanāgān prakalpayetevameva prakāreṇa maryādau ca vidhiṃ nyasetindrādīn sthāpayedvipra pūrvādīśāntaṃ vinyasetevameva prakāreṇa parivārāṇi vinyasetdvāradevāṃ susaṃsthāpya pūrvādikramayogataḥnandiṃ tu dakṣiṇe sthāpya kālaṃ cottaradeśakedaṇḍiṃ tu paścime sthāpya muṇḍiṃ tu pūrvato nyasetbhṛ"ngiṇī cottare sthāpya dakṣiṇe vijayaṃ tathā

sanskrit: anantaṃ pūrvata sthāpya paśupatiṃ paścime nyasetvṛṣabhasyāgrato vāpi pṛṣṭhato'tha viśeṣataḥ* * * mamāvyādau va sthāpayettu śivāgrataḥparivāravidhiḥ proktaṃ rakṣādīpaṃ śṛṇuṣvathārakṣādīpaṃ kathaṃ devaṃ tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabhorakṣādīpaṃ viśeṣeṇa trividhaṃ cocyate mayāsauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi tāmrajaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ tu vāpūrvaṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ caiva paścimaṃ cottaraṃ tathāaṣṭabandhasamutsedhaṃ vistaraṃ dvādaśaṃ bhavetpādaṃ caiva daśā"ngulyamutsedhaṃ tu vidhīyate* * * * * saṃyojya rakṣādīpaṃ tu kārayetvistāraṃ tu caturviṃśat a"ngulā sthalikā bhavetteṣāmūrdhve tu * * * * * * * * * tathānityanityārcane kuryāt tasyāṃ taddīpamucyatenityāgnikuṇḍaṃ viprendra * * * * * dīpayetsthālikāṃ vinyasettatra śikhāmantreṇa saṃyutamvartiṃ tatraiva vinyasya sannidhau dīpayettataḥpūrṇena puruṣeṇaiva aghoraṃ dakṣiṇena tuvyomavyāpi sama * * pañcabrahmeṇa saṃyutamgaṇikāṃ devadāsī vā dhārayeddīpamuttamamsarvama"ngalasaṃyuktaṃ śa"nkhadhvanisamāyutamgacchetpradakṣiṇaṃ tatra ninayet śivasannidhauīśānena tu mantreṇa arcayeddīpameva caekaṃ vāpi trayaṃ vāpi pradakṣiṇamathācaretetat śāntikamityuktaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ ca matha śṛṇu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00608 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vinyaset sthālikāṃ tatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥgarbhagehe sthite dīpe vartiṃ saṃyojayettataḥhṛdayena tu mantreṇa dīpaṃ dadyāt śivasya tuvisarjayettato mantrī bhasmaṃ śirasi nikṣipetevaṃ pauṣṭikamevaṃ tu kāmadaṃ śṛṇu tattvataḥsaptapātraika viprendra dīpaṃ saṃyojayettataḥśive dīpaṃ susaṃyojya visarjayetpūrvavatkramātuttamaṃ dīpamākhyātaṃ saptā"ngulasamucchrayamuttamaṃ goghṛtenaiva madhyamaṃ ajasaṃbhavedūrvākṣataiśca saṃyuktaṃ darpaṇaṃ bhasmameva cadīpasya darśanaṃ mūrdhni śive dadyāt viśeṣataḥyāntenaiva samāyuktaṃ ikārasvarasaṃyutametanmantraṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ stavastrotraprakāśikamkaraṇḍamakuṭaṃ yuktaṃ saumyarūpaṃ sulocanamevaṃvidhaṃ svarūpaṃ tu dhyātvā vai pūjayettataḥ? balavikaraṇīṃ balapramathanīṃ sarvabhūtadamanīṃ manonmanīmmadhye manonmanīṃ nyasya pūjayeddevabāhyataḥevameva krameṇaiva svasvarnāmena pūjayetsāyāhne śayanaṃ kuryādevameva krameṇa tusarvapāpairvinirmuktaśśivalokamavāpnuyāta"nkurārpaṇaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabhotatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsanautsavā"nkuramevoktaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu viśeṣataḥathā traya"nkuraṃ vidyāt dhvajā"nkuraṃ tu cocyatesthāpane prokṣaṇe yāge utsave snapane tathā

sanskrit: śrīkaraṃ śrīnivāsaṃ ca śrīpadaṃ ca tridhā bhavetkṛtvā navapadaṃ tatra devatāśca śṛṇuṣvathadakṣiṇena yajurvedamākāśaṃ caiva nairṛtevāyavye pavanaṃ caiva atharvaṃ somake pademadhyame tu pade caiva somakumbhapratiṣṭhitametat śrīkaramityuktaṃ śrīnivāsamatha śṛṇuṣoḍaśātpādamevāhurdevatānāṃ śṛṇuṣvathasugrīvo varuṇaśśeṣo mukhyassomoditastathāīśānaṃ caiva sugrīvo mukhyasya tu padāni cajayanto vijayaścaiva varuṇo soma eva caādityaśca yamaścaiva śoṣaśca vādini sthitāetadvai śrīnivāsaṃ tu śrīpadaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvathapañcaviṃśatpadaṃ kṛtvā pūjayetkramaśastathābhṛ"ngaṃ ca mṛgasugrīvo varuṇaśśoṣamārutauāpa vatsārdha sāvitri vivasvāgnilamitrakaḥbrahmāṇaṃ ca pade caiva sthāpayet somakumbhakampitṛdauvārikaścaiva mārutaścaiva mukhyakaḥāpavatsādi devāṣṭau ghaṭikā sthānamucyatesauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi kārayetpālikāmukhavistāraṃ viṃśatya"ngulamuttamamvistāreṇa samotsedhaṃ tadardhaṃ pādavistarammadhyame bilasaṃyuktaṃ darpaṇodaravatkṛtamghaṭikodara vistāraṃ dvādaśā"ngulamucyatepālikāpādavatkuryāt ghaṭilakṣaṇamucyatetadardhaṃ pādavistāraṃ tripādaṃ vā samucyate

sanskrit: ghaṭikā brahmadaivatyaṃ pālikā viṣṇurucyatecaturviṃśatisaṃkhyāttu uttamaṃ tu vinirdiśetpālikā cāṣṭa vinyasya madhyamaṃ tadihocyatenavame saptame vāpi pañcame taṃ yajetsadāgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt triśūlena samāyutamtadante pālikādīni dhārayet śivabhaktakānsuśuddhaṃ bhūtalaṃ prāpya prokṣayet śuddhavāriṇākundāliṃ caiva saṃpūjya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥmṛdaṃ saṃgrāhya vāmena hṛdīnā mṛdamarcayetprāsādasyograto vāpi īśāne dakṣiṇe tathāaṣṭadroṇena śālissyāt sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayettataḥmadhyame somakumbhaṃ tu vinyasetsomabījakaiḥgandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya naivedyaṃ dāpayettataḥdarbheṇa suṣiraṃ nyasya mṛdaṃ tatraiva pūrayetpuṇyāhaṃ tatra kurvīta tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ* * vaśipi saṃyuktaṃ apāmārgaṃ ca sarṣapampayasā kṣālayettatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥpāpayet śivamantreṇa * * * * stu vāpayetsomādhidevatākumbhān abhiṣicya tato jalamsuṣuptadeśe saṃsthāpya somakumbhena saṃyutamhavirnivedayettatra tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥhomayeccaiva viprendra apūpāni tathaiva caa"nkurārpaṇahīne tu rājarāṣṭrasya doṣakṛtevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaśśivaloke mahīyatetatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana

sanskrit: utgataṃ tutsavo yasmāt tasmādutsavamucyatejvara * māryāpravarttaṃ tu śatrupīḍaneṣu casarveṣāmiṣṭakāmārthaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanamdvividhaṃ utsavaṃ caiva tayorbhedaṃ śṛṇuṣvathapuṣyamāse tu puṣyāntaṃ māghamāse maghāntakamvaiśākhe tu viśākhāntaṃ mūlāntaṃ śreṣṭhamāsakepūrvāṣāḍhaṃ ca mevoktaṃ pūrvabhādreti māsakekṛttike kṛttikāntaṃ tu kārayettu śivotsavamkartuśca janmanakṣatre kuryādutsavamucyateśaivaṃ gauṇaṃ vibhūtaṃ ca bhauvanaṃ devikaṃ tathāeteṣāṃ bhedakaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsanatriyāhena samāyuktaṃ gauṇamityabhidhīyatenavāhena samāyuktaṃ daivikaṃ utsavaṃ smṛtamśanaiścarasya vāre tu tathā kāmadamucyateeteṣāṃ tu krameṇaiva vakṣyate vidhinā'dhunāhomaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau bali bhramaṇamācaretaparedyuścaiva viprendra tīrthaṃ kuryāttu deśikaḥtriyaheṣu ca viprendra sāyaṃkāle samārabhetidamanyatprakāreṇa triyahaṃ vakṣyate'dhunāhomaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau tadrātrau balimārabhetbalyante caiva viprendra cūrṇotsavaṃ tu kārayetpañcāhaṃ tu pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsanahomaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau baliṃ caiva dadet punaḥtīrthaṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa idamanya śṛṇuṣaṣṭhāhe tu ca pūrvāhṇe cūrṇotsavaṃ tu kārayet

sanskrit: sāyaṃkāle samārabhya pañcāhaṃ syāt dine tathādvitīye ca tṛtīye ca caturthaṃ tu balidvayamkuryādvai tīrthakarmaṃ tu dvividhaṃ cocyate mayāaṣṭāhe caiva sāyāhne adhivāsanamārabhetcaturdaśabaliṃ dadyāt cūrṇotsavaṃ tu kārayetsaptāhe sāyamārabhya adhivāsya tato budhaḥdvitīye divase caiva tṛtīye'pi caturthakesaptāhaṃ balirekā syāt balyante cūrṇamucyatesaptāhaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ navāhaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvathahomaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau baliṃ caiva tu dāpayetcūrṇotsavaṃ tataḥ kuryāt tīrthaṃ kuryāttate budhaḥnavāhe caiva sāyāhne adhivāsanamārabhetdvitīya divase caiva tṛtīye'pi caturthakamnavāhe'pi ca viprendra daśāhe tu baliṃ kṣipetnavāhe dvividhaṃ kuryāt procyate kamalāsanavārapūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsanapuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra havirnivedayettataḥnityotsavasya kāle tu kuryāt grāmapradakṣiṇampraviśedālayaṃ tatra pādukārcanamucyateli"nge vā pratimāyāṃ vā tailābhya"ngamihocyatehavirnivedayetpaścāt lokapālabaliṃ kṣipetgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt sarvatodya samanvitamsāyaṃkālaṃ samārabhya prātaḥkāle baliṃ dadetmaṇṭapāt dakṣiṇe pārśve sthāpayet kalaśaṃ navasamidājyacarūṃścaiva suhutvā pañcaviṃśatiḥ

sanskrit: baliṃ dadyāttu viprendra sāyaṃkāle viśeṣataḥtīrthaṃ kuryāttato vidvān praviśedālayaṃ pratimārttāṇḍīyamidaṃ proktaṃ * māraṃ ca śṛṇu dvijasamidājyacarūṃśvaiva * * * * * pūrvakama"nkurānarpayedvidvān dhvajamāropayettataḥdhvajamāropayet paścāt bherīṃ caiva tu tāḍayetbherīṃ tu tāḍayitvā tu dhvajamāropayettataḥevameva krameṇaiva trividhaṃ cocyate mayādviguṇīkṛtya vā kuryāddhvajamāropayettataḥbhauvane daivike kuryādanyeṣu ca vivarjayetyaddineṣu prabhā kuryāt tatpūrve vā pare'pi vānadīnada taṭākeṣu nakṣatre tīrthamucyatetaddine saṃkramo bhāge divā tīrthaṃ ca niścayaḥevameva krameṇaiva utsavaṃ kārayettataḥprāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryāt maṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakamdarbhamālābhirāveṣṭya puṣpamālāvalambitamlokapālādhidaivatyaṃ svasvarūpaṃ tu lāñcayetvitānenordhvamācchādya muktādāmairalaṃkṛtammudgānnaṃ caiva dātavyaṃ upadaṃśa samanvitamaṣṭadroṇena śāliṃ tu tadardhaṃ taṇḍulairapitasyopari nyasettatra kalaśānnavasaṃkhyayāpūrayet gandhatoyena svarṇaṃ tatra vinikṣipetpūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ vinyasedaṣṭakumbhakānācamanaṃ dakṣiṇe tasya phalodakaṃ tu nairṛteuttare pañcagavyaṃ tu īśe ratnodakaṃ nyaset

sanskrit: ? dhānyān kāmānyakāmāya toṃ tāntānvai sādhayet dhvajaḥśa"nkhasphaṭikamuktābhaṃ rakṣārthaṃ śāntipuṣṭikamrātrau vaiśyasya śūdrāṇāṃ vardhate kramaśastathāpīṭhagopurayormadhye vṛṣasya ca purato'pi vākramukaṃ veṇudaṇḍaṃ ca candanaṃ vāpi khādiramavakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ caiva kṛmikoṭaravarjitamvṛṣabhasthala samaṃ vāpi gopurotsedhameva cahastasaṃkhyena vā kuryāt triṃśaddhastamathāpi vāsaptatriṃśā"ngulaṃ vāpi caturviṃśatireva vāveṇuyaṣṭiṃ tato grāhya avakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ tataḥtriparvaṃ vyādhinaṃ pīḍyaṃ catuṣparva vināśinaḥsaptaparvān gavāṃ nāśaḥ aṣṭaparvaistu vardhateekādaśaṃ putrakāmaḥ dvādaśaṃ puṣṭikāmadamṣaṭtālaṃ pañcatālaṃ vā tasyāgre ghaṭikāṃ nyasethastamātrāntaraṃ jñeyaṃ hastaṃ vā suṣiradvayamagraghaṭikāmūlāntaṃ rajjudviguṇaṃ kārayetnavavastraparīdhānā soṣṇīyaṃ cottarīyakamtasyānte cāstrarājānamannali"ngasamāyutamnānājanasamākīrṇaṃ nānāvādyasamāyutamma"ngalā"nkurasamāyuktaṃ nṛttageyasamanvitamśanaiḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā dhvajasthānaṃ praverayettasya mūle prakartavyaṃ vedilakṣaṇasaṃyutampuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra prokṣayet śuddhavāriṇādarbhamālābhirāveṣṭya puṣpamālāsamanvitamutthāya dhvajadaṇḍaṃ tu vyomavyāpi samuccaran

sanskrit: tasya mūle prakartavyaṃ vedikālakṣaṇaṃ tataḥvistaraḥ procyate vipra utsedhaṃ tu tadardhakamevamekhalamevaṃ syāt mekhalātrayameva caadhastamekhalā caiva bhūmidevīṃ tu vinyasettrimekhaleṣu viprendra śaktīnāṃ traya kalpayetpūjayedgandhapuṣpeṇa dhūpadīpaissamanvitampuṇyāhaṃ kārayettatra kalaśān vinyasennavamindrādīśānaparyantaṃ vinyaset kalaśaṃ tataḥsnāpayitvā yathānyāyaṃ vṛṣayantrī ca mantrataḥ? etatkāle tu pūjātīnāṃ piṇḍānyān bhojayettataḥvṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa piṇḍaṃ dadyāttu deśikaḥnamaskāraṃ tu kartavyaṃ dhvajamūle samāśritaḥanyajātistu sarveṣāṃ pratilomāśca kārayettāmbūlaṃ dāpayettasmai janānsarvānviśeṣataḥprātarmadhyāhnasāyāhne dhvajamāropayettataḥlakṣaṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsanavyadhavṛkṣeṇa vā kuryāt bherīṃ vā paṭahaṃ tu vāpañcatālaṃ tu madhyaṃ syāt ṣaḍa"ngulavihīnakamāyāmasya samaṃ nāhaṃ madhye paṭahamucyateevameva krameṇaiva kṛtvā paṭahamuttamammaddalaiḥ kāhalaiścaiva kāṃsyadhvanisamāyutamanyaiśca sarvavādyaiśca yathālābhena tāḍayetmaṇṭapasya tu madhye tu gomayenānulepayetaṣṭadroṇena śālī syāt sthaṇḍilau dvau tu kārayetpadmapatraṃ samālikhya darbhaiścaiva paristaret

sanskrit: paṭahaṃ vinyasettatra navavastrasamanvitamgandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpaiścaruṃ nivedayetuttarābhimukho bhūtvā arcayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥpaṭahaṃ vinyasettatra hṛdayena tu pūjayetbrahmāṇaṃ pūjayenmadhye evameva krameṇa tumātarassanti kīle tu udare tu vyavasthitaḥvādyakaṃ ca samāhūya sthānakarma samācaretnandikeśvaramāvāhya nandimantrasamanvitampaṭahasyaiva viprendra havirnivedayettataḥvāmadevena mantreṇa arcayitvā viśeṣataḥvādyakastāḍayetpaścāt nandimantreṇa saṃyutamcarcapuṭaṃ tu brahmāṇaṃ cācapuṭa dvitīyakenamāmi devīṃ varadāṃ sarasvatīmtaṃtrāṇāmadbhavaṃ kiñcit tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabhotanoti vipulānarthān tatvamantrasamāśritānkāmikaṃ yogajaṃ ciṃtyaṃ kāraṇaṃ tvajitaṃ tathāvijayañcaiva niśvāsaṃ svāyaṃbhuvamayānilamsarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvavighnaharaṃ śubhamaṣṭabandhaṃ tato hīne rājarāṣṭrasya doṣakṛtdarśane bandhane hīne santānaṃ nāśayetkramātbaliṃ nityotsavañcaiva varjyaṃ prādakṣiṇaṃ tapamupacārāṇi sarvāṇi niṣphalañca tathā bhavetphālgune caivavaiśākhe puṣyamāte tu cottamaḥvarjayecānyamāteṣu viṣaye ca vihīnakedinavāramuhūrtañca varjayeddeśikottamaḥ
